domains.name: SOC & Detection Engineering
domains.description: Alert triage speed, rule quality, and incident response workflow acceleration.
domains.privacyNotice: Mostly local analytics; optional enrichment is explicitly gated.

domains.name: Threat Intel & DFIR
domains.description: IOC quality scoring, exchange format normalization, and forensic packaging.
domains.privacyNotice: Intel normalization runs local-first with optional external context lookups.

domains.name: Network & Exposure Security
domains.description: Exposure import normalization, ACL conflict detection, and TLS risk analysis.
domains.privacyNotice: Analysis is local by default; probes are network-labeled before execution.

domains.name: Application & API Security
domains.description: API contract abuse checks, authz drift detection, and browser policy hardening.
domains.privacyNotice: Contract linting and policy checks process documents fully in-browser.

domains.name: Cloud & IAM Security
domains.description: Identity policy review and least-privilege hygiene across cloud providers.
domains.privacyNotice: Policy linting is local; no cloud credentials are required by default.

domains.name: Software Supply Chain Security
domains.description: Dependency risk diffing, tamper evidence, and provenance-oriented checks.
domains.privacyNotice: SBOM and lockfile analysis remain local unless users opt into lookups.

domains.name: Data Security & Privacy Engineering
domains.description: Sensitive-data handling, leakage detection, and privacy-preserving processing.
domains.privacyNotice: Privacy-focused tools prioritize local-only processing and explicit consent.
